type Raw string
var FailureNames
type Failure struct
  Error string
  Permanent bool
  Cause string
func Encode(v *Failure) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Failure, error)
func ToJSON(v any) (out []byte, err error)
func FromJSON(data []byte, v any) error
